$comment: Analytics taxonomy — auth family. Merged with its siblings by server/analytics.taxonomy(); see _envelope.json.

auth_state_observed.$comment: CHANGE-ONLY against a module-level last value: /api/auth/status is POLLED. EMITTED rather than derived from the transitions below, because an install may already hold a valid credential when analytics ships, or may never visit auth at all, and would emit none of them.
auth_state_observed.question: What share of installs can actually use the agent?

auth_prompt_shown.$comment: On the showConnect false->true TRANSITION (a useEffect), never inside the render expression — React renders more than once per state change.
auth_prompt_shown.question: Who sees the sign-in wall?

oauth_started.question: Do users begin OAuth at all?

auth_connect_finished.$comment: Was `auth_connected` (success only). RENAMED and widened: the failure branches did not exist, so setup conversion had a numerator and no denominator. `outcome` is CLASSIFIED from the error text at the emit site — the raw text can quote a pasted code, a URL or a provider message.
auth_connect_finished.question: What is setup conversion, and what breaks it?

auth_needs_reauth.$comment: One per TRANSITION into the error state, not per failing call — mark_auth_error is reached by every 401 in a turn.
auth_needs_reauth.question: What breaks users who were already connected?

byok_var_saved.$comment: Provider FAMILY only, computed from a closed list BEFORE capture. _SECRET_HINT would not have saved us: it tests the KEY name, so var_name='ANTHROPIC_API_KEY' rides through unredacted (verified).
byok_var_saved.question: Which providers do users actually pay for?
